title: College Reunion Song (sheet music)
text:
College Reunion Song

Words by Martha Buford May    1940

[Sheet music with melody and lyrics. Verses:]

1. We now have come to-geth - er from the corners of the State To en - joy this great re - un - ion.
2. Some are more ad - vanced in years, while others younger be, And still it makes no dif-f'rence.
3. Time on time has touched our brow, and turned our locks to gray, But this old bond still holds us.

[Chorus:]
Hap-py, hap-py, hap-py are we, Hap-py, hap-py, hap-py are we,
Hap-py, hap-py, hap-py are we, When we are gath-ered here.
notes: Sheet music for the 'College Reunion Song,' words by Martha Buford May (1940). Lyrics transcribed as best readable; musical notation not transcribed.
